title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: After Nila tells Nadesan about the lost jewelry, a passenger returns the bangle to Chozhan. He gifts it to an emotional Nila, hugs his family, and shares a private moment.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Mathi plans a secret movie trip for Lakshmi, while Bagyaraj and Suresh request Ragavan to take the whole family. A stressed Ragavan visits Revathi and complains to Thangaraj.

title: Bigg Boss
description: Ansar’s salt heist sparks laughs, but food scarcity triggers chaos. The game turns sinister as Asmitha and Jason unite via secret codewords to hunt their first target.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Savithri and Thamarai celebrate Eshwari and Chithra's arrest with great relief. Sannasi kneels before Rajangam, overwhelmed by his wife and daughter's betrayal.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu asks Shyam for a year to think about marriage. Arjun challenges Shyam that Madhu will not go on a date with him, while Sankar finds Pooja happy at Karikalan's house.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani grows upset when Mathangi informs her about expediting the divorce from Anbu. Meanwhile, Vennila rejects Mayuri's request for a grand celebration of Maya's birthday.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Abhi delays starting married life with Shanmugam. While Murugan surprises Indhira on the terrace, Shanmugam's bed coffee and Abhi's dress shock Lakshmi.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Kathir joins the celebrations as Gomathi and Pandian prepare for their wedding vows. However, Gomathi grows emotional due to her family's absence on the special occasion.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu and Meena market their Gulkand products across shops. Manoj narrowly escapes being spotted with Kanaga when Rohini visits Devika to invite her to the parlour opening.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Sandhya proposes to Vetri at her birthday party, but he rejects her. Vetri spends time with an angry Sudar, while a heartbroken Sandhya finds comfort in Vethanayagam.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Pechi and Sarasu are shocked to find Manthiyan's memorial posters torn down and inform Poongodi. Mayandi sets Azhagar a test to produce 100 bags of paddy on 3 acres.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: As people cast their votes, Paraman and Ilamathi anxiously await the election results. Paraman grows increasingly worried as Sidharth takes the lead in the vote counting.
